# Three-way tie on points: head to head is level (each beat one), so goal difference decides.
teams 4
stage round_robin
play 1-2 1 10:2
play 2-3 2 10:9
play 1-3 3 10:8
play 1-4 1
play 2-4 2
play 3-4 3
expect finished
# 1: +8 −2 +5 = 11; 2: −8 +1 +5 = −2; 3: −1 +2 +5 = 6
expect standings 1 - 1 3 2 4
expect placements 1:1 2:3 3:2
